title: Overview
description: Your desktop, configuration, and installation health.

actions.title: System status
actions.description: Hardware, packages, configurations, themes, shell, and Hyprland.

actions.title: Verify installation
actions.description: Check package installation, critical tools, configuration links, and theme assets.

title: Packages
description: Keep installed software and your package lists in sync.

actions.title: Reconcile packages
actions.description: Review missing, extra, and dependency packages. Install missing software, choose what to keep, remove extras, update manifests, or perform a full sync.

actions.title: Install all tracked packages
actions.description: Install the official and AUR packages declared in dotfiles, including preparation and verification.

actions.title: Manage unlisted packages
actions.description: Select which unlisted packages to keep, add them to dotfiles, or remove them from the system.

actions.title: Package details
actions.description: Inspect official, AUR, installed, and tracked package counts and differences.

title: Updates
description: Keep your system and apps up to date.

title: Cleanup
description: Review storage and choose what to clear.

title: Temporary installs
description: Try a package, then keep it or remove it.

title: Configurations
description: Manage the configuration packages linked into your home folder.

actions.title: Manage configuration links
actions.description: Choose which packages stay linked. Existing selections are preserved and changes are reviewed before applying.

actions.title: Link all configurations
actions.description: Link every stow package, clean stale links, and update configured user services.

actions.title: Unlink all configurations
actions.description: Remove all dotfiles-managed configuration links. This includes the shell and this widget; the operation continues in the background.

actions.title: Configuration details
actions.description: Inspect every stow package and its current link state.

title: Hardware
description: Detected devices and the drivers that support them.

actions.title: Set up hardware
actions.description: Detect this machine, install the matching driver packages, and generate GPU configuration. A reboot may be needed.

actions.title: Hardware details
actions.description: Inspect detected GPU, CPU, device type, and hardware-managed packages.

title: System configuration
description: Power, boot, networking, login, and other system settings.

actions.title: Apply system configurations
actions.description: Apply the existing power, sleep, logind, build, timezone, DNS, Bluetooth, ESP32, greeter, and boot setup scripts. Some changes require a reboot.

actions.title: Configuration details
actions.description: Check which system configurations are available and applied.

title: Appearance
description: Wallpaper-derived colors, GTK themes, and matching cursors.

actions.title: Install a GTK theme
actions.description: Choose a theme, light or dark appearance, and standard or solid variant. Apply the theme and matching cursor using the existing GTK workflow.

actions.title: Uninstall the current theme
actions.description: Remove the current theme using the existing GTK uninstall workflow.

actions.title: Theme details
actions.description: Inspect matugen, generated theme assets, GTK appearance, and cursor settings.

title: Shell
description: Zsh, Oh My Zsh, plugins, and your default shell.

actions.title: Set up shell
actions.description: Set up zsh, Oh My Zsh, configured plugins, terminfo, and Starship. Choose whether to change your default shell when prompted.

actions.title: Shell details
actions.description: Inspect the current shell and installed plugin configuration.

actions.title: Set up Hyprland
actions.description: Configure detected monitors and the repository's Hyprland plugins. The compositor configuration may reload.

actions.title: Hyprland details
actions.description: Inspect compositor, monitor, GPU configuration, and plugin status.

title: Installation
description: Complete setup, resume interrupted work, and inspect installation state.

actions.title: Full installation
actions.description: Run all existing install phases: preflight, hardware, packages, configurations, system setup, themes, shell, Hyprland, and verification. This changes the live desktop.

actions.title: Resume installation
actions.description: Continue the existing installer from its last failed phase using saved state.

actions.title: Installation state
actions.description: View completed and failed phases and the available resume point.

title: Activity
description: Progress, questions, and results from your latest operation.
